backend_definitions.label: Price at/below the existing 200-day average
backend_definitions.definition: Existing selected EMA200, otherwise SMA200, distance <= 0 percent.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Bollinger compression
backend_definitions.definition: Existing bb_width_pctile <= 20; the upstream estimator is not redefined here.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Supply dry-up
backend_definitions.definition: Existing volume_dryup <= 0.8; upstream reference window is not redefined here.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing structural confirmation
backend_definitions.definition: At least two higher lows OR truthy OBV/AD divergence OR bottom phase ACCUMULATION OR flag LIKELY_BOTTOM.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing flow-clue gate
backend_definitions.definition: At least one existing flows evidence row. These legacy clues are not verified ETF creations/redemptions or signed trades.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing catalyst-clue gate
backend_definitions.definition: At least one existing catalysts evidence row.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing RSI reset
backend_definitions.definition: Selected bottom-model RSI, otherwise row RSI/rsi_14, <= 45.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing dilution coverage
backend_definitions.definition: Non-stock OR dilution observed OR net_issuer flag observed OR net buyback yield observed. The existing veto gate separately checks severity.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing confidence floor
backend_definitions.definition: Existing candidate confidence (including its existing fallback) >= 0.60; this is not a calibrated probability.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing vetoes
backend_definitions.definition: No existing vetoes: location, observed ADV below $1M, modeled R/R below 2, dilution >= 10%, or net issuer. Missing ADV retains existing behavior.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing entry geometry
backend_definitions.definition: Valid planned stop < entry < target and (target-entry)/(entry-stop) >= 2.5.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Existing risk permission
backend_definitions.definition: Existing risk_allows_entries flag is true; this evidence never grants permission.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence

backend_definitions.label: Observed entry trigger
backend_definitions.definition: entry_triggered is True OR daily_4h_triggered is True. Without this, an otherwise qualified entry remains ARMED.
backend_definitions.provenance: scoring.py:score_candidate; recorded native gate, not independently validated market evidence
